title: So pleasant and informative
text: Laura, our guide, was so knowledgeable and so animated!  She was friendly, Savvy and her English was excellent!  Her vocabulary was proficient and colorful! Her tour was flexible, she was punctual, and she really tailored it to our interests and preferences. And she was also very careful about making sure my food allergies were taken into consideration. We really enjoyed this activity. Thank you, Laura.
author: npmd
